privacy.title: Privacy policy

privacy.dataText: When using the contact form, we collect: your name, email address, subject and message content. This information is used solely to respond to your inquiry and is never sold or shared with third parties.

privacy.retentionText: Contact form data is retained for a maximum of 3 years from the date of your request, in accordance with applicable regulations.
